processing_note: All the above travel expenses of KI and the members of her entourage shall be billed directly to Diplomat.

contract.document_name.rationale: The contract calls itself the Endorsement Agreement (title, preamble, and the addendum's reference); the addendum's own title is a different name.

contract.agreement_date.rationale: 'made and entered into as of August 24, 1995', restated in the addendum; the Deal Memo date and addendum signature dates are other roles.

contract.effective_date.rationale: The license term commences August 1, 1995 (the agreement itself is dated August 24, 1995); the license-year table dates are royalty-schedule entries.

contract.expiration_date.rationale: Paragraph 2(c): the term continues until January 30, 2000; 1/30/2000 in the royalty table is a license-year boundary.

contract.governing_law.rationale: Paragraph 24(c) applies the laws of the State of California; other occurrences are addresses or insurer qualification.

contract.renewal_term.rationale: The agreement has no renewal provision.

contract.notice_period.rationale: No renewal and therefore no notice period to prevent renewal; the options are statement, termination and sell-off periods.
